subject: Portfolio Allocation Review – Meeting Request
body:
Dear Mr. Lindqvist,

I hope this message finds you well.

In the course of our regular portfolio monitoring, we noted that your current cash position stands at USD 14.2 million, representing 45.0% of your portfolio against a target ceiling of 18%. Similarly, your allocation to Cash and Equivalents is at 44.98%, compared to the mandated band of 2–18%, placing it approximately 27 percentage points above the upper limit.

We would welcome the opportunity to discuss these figures with you in more detail and to review your portfolio's positioning together. Please let us know a convenient time for a meeting at your earliest convenience.

We look forward to speaking with you soon.

Kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
